title: Missing tx_queue_destroy implementation (resource leak)
description:
Function tx_queue_destroy is declared in tx_queue.h:231 and called in production code (lora_l2.c:603) and tests (main.c:488), but no implementation exists in tx_queue.c. This causes either a linker error or, if weak-linked, a resource leak where pthread_mutex_destroy is never called on POSIX systems.

File: lichen/subsys/lichen/link/tx_queue.c
Line: 448
close_reason: Already fixed: tx_queue_destroy is implemented in tx_queue.c lines 451-467 with proper pthread_mutex_destroy call for POSIX and no-op for Zephyr
